mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a comfortable 69 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. Plus, tonight at 8:27 PM, you can catch the space station as it passes from the Northwest over Verona High School toward the Northeast near Home Depot, staying low near the horizon.

City maintenance is on the horizon with chip sealing starting September 23 on various roads including Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to review several development projects throughout the area.

There is plenty to do in our community. Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run today, and don't miss the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli or the Dane County Farmers' Market in Madison tomorrow.
A notable call occurred on September 10, when officers responded to an in-progress burglary on Hunters Cove Way and successfully detained a 19-year-old suspect.
Although the store is undergoing an exciting remodel today, you can still stop by until 10:30 PM to get your food. Today's flavor is not available due to the construction work.
